predeclared_plan.task: Training-only necessary shape conditions for a shared nonnegative field-only loss channel; no new physical fit or ODE
predeclared_plan.original_reset_score_mask: finite observed magnitude >=1e-12 A and nonzero voltage; preserve all 2799 points; diagnostics do not redefine this mask
background_scenarios: zero background at RESET and preceding SET read
prior_SET_conditioned full-training fixed background from frozen field_rupture_trial.npz; also use its fixed SET-read background, never refit
predeclared_plan.normalization: Q=(I-B)/v, a0=G_SET-B_SET(+0.05)/0.05, r=Q/a0; preserve negative excess and r>1; never clip or log nonpositive excess
predeclared_plan.pure_loss_conditions: a(v)<=a0 and r nonincreasing along acquisition path; report outward pre-peak and complete-path violations without deleting local increases

robust_diagnostic_window.meaning: Predeclared high-signal comparison window, not a calibrated measurement-noise bound or a new score/feature mask

predeclared_plan.common_shape: At each native branch/voltage node report positive normalized span and robust subset span with member IDs; no adaptive voltage selection or interpolation
predeclared_plan.relative_band_convention: Symmetric linear relative bands applied to original current I: [(1-delta)I,(1+delta)I]. Background remains fixed. Report minimal delta for normalized interval intersection with SET exact, and with both RESET and SET readings independently in same delta band
predeclared_plan.fixed_background_delta: Intersect original-current intervals after subtracting fixed RESET and SET backgrounds. Solve scalar interval-contact condition only while all interval excesses remain strictly positive; otherwise mark nonpositive-excess domain limit rather than clipping
predeclared_plan.delta_scope: Per-node optimistic necessary tolerance only; one SET-read perturbation must in reality serve all voltages, and a common monotone path must fit all nodes. No measurement-noise estimate or global-trajectory sufficiency claim
predeclared_plan.branch_product: Pair exact same-voltage outward/return native points within each record. Evaluate log10(Qout)+log10(Qreturn) only when both observations pass original mask and both pass high-signal window with positive excess; report unusable fractions and reasons over all 1400 native nonzero branch pairs
predeclared_plan.branch_product_assumptions: Common nonnegative voltage-only hazard on symmetric triangle, fixed B(v), same path clock outward/return and no intervening wait. Unknown dwell/wait metadata remain unknown

arbitrary_common_background_relaxation.assumptions: Passive path; previous SET read conductance bounds starting hard-path amplitude; same background B(v) for every cycle; hard path only loses conductance throughout RESET
arbitrary_common_background_relaxation.scope: Loose pointwise necessary condition using a0<=G_SET since G_SET includes nonnegative background. Does not fit or scan Gamma, does not prove full dynamics feasible, does not exclude cycle/state-dependent evolving backgrounds. Relative bands are sensitivity allowances, not measured noise

static_within_record_background_differen.nominal_condition: 0 <= Iout(v)-Ireturn(v) <= v*G_SET for a matched-voltage pair
static_within_record_background_differen.eligibility: Both original scoring observations eligible. No requirement that return current exceed10uA, since no background subtraction or logarithm is used. Record outward/return high-signal flags separately
static_within_record_background_differen.assumptions: Same-v background static within each record, but may differ between cycles; passive hard channel purely loses conductance from SET-read through RESET; a0<=G_SET
static_within_record_background_differen.scope: Loose necessary bound, not parameter fitting or full-history prediction. Relative bands are sensitivity allowances, not noise calibration. One SET perturbation must serve all nodes; no per-node material reinitialization

arbitrary_common_background_relaxation.scope: Loose necessary bound for passive pure loss with a0<=G_SET and one nonnegative B(v) shared by cycles. No Gamma fitting; per-node pass is not full-trajectory feasibility; excludes no cycle/state-dependent background.

static_within_record_background_differen.scope: Same-v subtraction cancels any background static within each record, even if it differs by cycle. Requires passive pure loss with a0<=G_SET, no growth from SET read. Original mask retained; no log or requirement of high return current. Relative bands are sensitivity allowances.

scope: Only original14 training IDs accessed. No held-out array loaded, no scoring denominator or original feature gate changed.
Normalized a0 is conditional on the measured preceding SET50mV read; this does not predict SET formation or full history.
A pure-loss channel must stay below a0 and decline along acquisition path. Raw local increases and values above1 remain in outputs.
The10uA and1% window is predeclared robustness screening, not calibrated instrument resolution or new fitting acceptance.
Relative tolerances are deterministic sensitivity allowances, not measurement noise estimates, confidence intervals, or fitted physical parameters.
Per-node interval overlap is only an optimistic necessary condition: the same SET-read perturbation must serve all voltages, and one common monotone shape must work across nodes.
Branch-product requires positive resolvable excess on both branches; absence of such points leaves this identity untested, not failed.
Common nonnegative voltage-only hazard additionally assumes equal path clock on outward and return, symmetric triangle and no wait. Timing remains unknown.
Fixed full-training background is a conditional scenario, not independently established truth. No choice of arbitrary free background was fitted.
Failures do not identify a microscopic replacement mechanism or exclude state-dependent backgrounds, non-ohmic high channels, nonmonotone readout, or protocol variation.
